verdict.rationale: Firebase's docs say it can 'store and sync app data' and that Cloud Firestore lets apps 'listen to' data, even offline. Hands-on community reports back this up: one developer synced live positions to multiple clients at once for a whiteboarding app, and another added real-time notifications in a few hours. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the listener/snapshot subscription API, explicit documentation of change-event semantics for UI updates, and recent hands-on corroboration for Firestore specifically (the community reports concern the original Firebase database).
